title: Answers to a choice end with one concrete action
prompt: I hesitate between preparing tomorrow's call with a researcher or finishing the interview synthesis document tonight. What would you do?
rules: Finish with ONE concrete action doable today in under 90 minutes
llm_criteria: The answer recommends one of the two options instead of saying it depends.
The last line is a single concrete action that fits in under 90 minutes.
The answer addresses the user directly (you).
